description: React component 'GameBoard' that manages the state and interactions for a tic-tac-toe game, including mode selection, handling moves, AI integration, and UI rendering.

methods.name: GameBoard
methods.description: Main React functional component for interacting with the tic-tac-toe game.

methods.name: onCellClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on individual game cells, validating and updating the game state.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets the game board to its initial empty state.

methods.name: handleModeChange
methods.description: Updates the game mode (PvP or Vs Computer) and resets the board when mode changes.
